stem:
The line graphed on the grid represents the first of two equations in a system of linear equations.

If the graph of the second equation in the system passes through the points (-12, 20) and (4, 12), which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The only solution to the system is (10, 5).

options.label: B
options.text: The only solution to the system is (0, 14).

options.label: D
options.text: The system has an infinite number of solutions.

visual_elements: Grid with line plotted from about (-20, 20) to (20, 0), axes labeled x and y with ticks and numbers.
